svg.font-family: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono', 'Noto Sans Mono', 'Noto Emoji', 'Noto Sans Symbols 2', 'Noto Sans Mono CJK JP', 'unifont_upper', 'unifont_csur', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

text.tspan: glob - Find files by glob pattern
MESSAGES Messages to send (prefix files with @)
python - Execute Python code (requires: omp setup python)
computer - Native host desktop capture and input (disabled by default)
--smol=<value> Smol/fast model for lightweight tasks (or PI_SMOL_MODEL env)
task - Launch sub-agents for parallel tasks
--slow=<value> Slow/reasoning model for thorough analysis (or PI_SLOW_MODEL
--plan=<value> Plan model for architectural planning (or PI_PLAN_MODEL env)
ask - Ask user questions (interactive mode only)
--prewalk Switch from the active model to a fast/cheap model at the fi
rst edit/write after the plan's todo list exists (default off; see prewalk.enabled)
--no-prewalk Disable prewalk even if prewalk.enabled is set
--prewalk-into=<value> Target model for prewalk (default the "smol" role)
--plan-yolo Force read-only plan mode at start, auto-approve the plan on
omp agents unpack - Export bundled subagents to ~/.omp/agent/agents (default)
omp agents unpack --project - Export bundled subagents to ./.omp/agents
